deployments_detail.use: Baker Hughes internal use of C3 AI applications for its own operations — sourcing optimization, inventory optimization and sustainability tracking (part of the expanded JV). [C3 AI]
"Leucipa" automated field production (AI/ML production optimization) + "Cordant" AI engines for energy asset ops; agentic AI added 2025

Leucipa automated field production solution — AI-powered software for field-wide oil & gas production optimization, reducing unplanned downtime and emissions. Piloted by Repsol (Lift Optimizer for plunger lift wells). SaaS hosted on AWS. [Baker Hughes (Leucipa); AWS (hosting)]

Leucipa 'Lucy' AI Production Assistant — generative-AI conversational interface giving real-time analysis of production data for field decision-making. Deployed across Expand Energy US natural gas fields (Marcellus, Utica, Haynesville). [Baker Hughes (Leucipa/Lucy); AWS]

Cordant industrial software — hybrid AI + physics-based predictive failure detection for turbomachinery (turbines, compressors, pumps) plus an AI Assistant for Work Management to accelerate case resolution. Enterprise deployment, 20+ languages. [Baker Hughes (Cordant); Microsoft Azure/AI Foundry partnership]

BHC3 Reliability — machine-learning predictive-maintenance application (early warning of equipment failure / production downtime) built via the Baker Hughes–C3 AI joint venture. Deployed to major energy operators (Shell, Eni, QatarEnergy LNG, ExxonMobil, etc.). JV renewed/expanded through 2028. [C3 AI; Microsoft Azure]
deployments_detail.value: $500M+ combined revenue from O&G/chemicals since 2019 (per C3 AI CEO)

deployments_detail.use: Waygate Technologies AI-powered non-destructive testing (NDT) inspection — deep-learning defect classification and anomaly detection trained on millions of inspection images/signals; products include Mentor Visual iQ+ borescope and Phoenix CT systems for aerospace, oil & gas, power gen, automotive. [Baker Hughes (Waygate Technologies)]

NVIDIA deep-learning predictive maintenance — deep learning applied to pumps, turbines and compressors to increase production and cut maintenance costs; also GPU-accelerated reservoir simulation. Described as proof-of-concept. [NVIDIA]
deployments_detail.value: 93% prediction accuracy; 5X reduction in false positives/negatives

deployments_detail.use: Google Cloud collaboration on AI-enabled power optimization and sustainability for data centers — combining Baker Hughes turbomachinery/power systems with Google Cloud AI to optimize power generation, management and consumption. Early/exploratory phase. [Google Cloud]

GenAI digital assistants 'JenAii' and 'Flow' — Flow supports field personnel with common questions on artificial-lift equipment; built by turning decades of documentation into an intelligent support bot. Rolled out with a repeatable framework for more assistants. [EPAM; AWS (generative AI)]
